# XZ Embedded

This subset is from [XZ Embedded](https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz-embedded/tree/ae63ae3a36ed01724674e8f3d750dc47bf125410), licensed under 0BSD. The C sources implement XZ streams, CRC32 and LZMA2. The configuration enables only bounded preallocated dictionary mode. The native firmware compiles these sources with its SDK C runtime.
